description: This file defines a PHP class 'Auth_Container_ADOdb' that implements a storage driver for fetching login data from a database using ADOdb-PHP. It includes methods for connecting to the database, querying user data, listing users, and managing user records, with external dependencies on PEAR and ADOdb libraries.

classes.name: Auth_Container_ADOdb
classes.description: A PHP class implementing a database-backed authentication storage driver using ADOdb-PHP.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database using the provided DSN.

methods.name: _prepare
methods.description: Prepares the database connection for queries.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query on the database.

methods.name: _setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration options for database connection.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Fetches user login data from the database for authentication.

methods.name: listUsers
methods.description: Lists all users stored in the database.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Adds a new user to the database.

methods.name: removeUser
methods.description: Removes a user from the database.
